units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 3:12">Ab. III, 12</cite> <he>הוי קל לראש ונ׳ לתשחורת</he> be quick (to serve) to thy superior, and kind to youth; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 2:2:2">Y. Taan. II, 65ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>ונ׳ תשח׳</he> (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 17:8">Gen. R. s. 17</cite> <he>מפני מה האיש נ׳ להתפתות וכ׳</he> why is man easily pacified, and woman not? <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 5:11">Ab. V, 11</cite> <he>נ׳ לכעוס ונ׳ וכ׳</he> easily angered and easily reconciled, opp. <he>קשה</he>.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 845:1">Yalk. Deut. 845</cite> <he>נֹחַ לקנות שונא וכ׳</he> it is easy to acquire an enemy, but hard to acquire a friend; <he>נח לעלות לבימה וכ׳</he> it is easy to be brought up to the platform of the court, but hard to come down (be acquitted); a. fr.—Pl. <he>נוֹחִים</he>, <he>נוֹחוֹת</he>, <cite ref="N00649"><he>נֹח׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 90:4">Gen. R. s. 90</cite> <he>ונח׳</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 148:7">Yalk. ib. 148</cite> <he>ונוח׳</he>, v. <cite ref="J00511"><he>יָפַע</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Eruvin 13b:14">Erub. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>נ׳ לו לאדם שלא נברא יותר וכ׳</he> it would have been better for man not to have been born at all than &c.

<cite ref="Shabbat 56b:12">Sabb. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>נ׳ לו לאותו … ואל וכ׳</he> it would have been better for that pious man, had he been a slave in an idolatrous temple, only that it might not be written about him &c.; a. fr.
